intro: Estana proves small spaces can have big style. Its compact design, with a durable MDF top and rubberwood frame, saves space while creating a warm, inviting dining nook you’ll love coming home to.

features.title: Smooth, easy-to-clean top
features.text: Made for everyday moments. The MDF dining tabletop is durable, easy to clean, and ready to handle everything from quick breakfasts to family feasts.

features.title: Strong wooden frame
features.text: Your family deserves furniture that lasts. Built with a solid rubberwood frame, it offers exceptional stability and everyday durability.

features.title: Classic mahogany finish
features.text: Bring timeless charm to your dining area—the warm mahogany finish adds depth and character you’ll love coming home to.

features.title: Compact design for small spaces
features.text: Perfect for smaller spaces—the Estana Set brings style and function to compact dining rooms without compromise.

features.title: Soft upholstered seating
features.text: Light-coloured upholstery contrasts beautifully with the darker table finish, creating a warm and inviting dining space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Estana 4-Seater Wooden Rectangular Dining Set
